title: public_domain_v1
description: Underlying source material. Whether the book, article, memoir, court transcript or archival document a production is adapting is free to use, licensed, or a chain of title problem. E&O carriers require a chain of title opinion and this is the research that feeds it.

status.description: Partially public domain is common and dangerous: an early edition may be free while a later revision, translation or annotated edition is not.

public_domain_in.description: Territories where the work is free. Term rules differ enough that a US public domain work can be encumbered in Europe.

term_basis.description: Which rule produced the term. Life plus a period, a fixed publication term, a restored foreign copyright, and so on.

derivative_layers.description: Translations, illustrations, annotations, and later editions each carry their own term and their own holder. Missing a layer is a classic chain of title defect.

renewal_checked.description: For works of the renewal era, non renewal is what put a great many of them into the public domain, and the registry is the only place that answer lives.
